title: SegDINO: An Efficient Design for Medical and Natural Image Segmentation with DINO-V3
mechanism: Frozen DINOv3 multi-level features aligned to one resolution and decoded by a light MLP head.
evidence: R (abstract): SOTA on TN3K, Kvasir-SEG, ISIC and 3 natural sets with few trainable params.
adaptation: Benchmark reference row only (frozen VFM + light head); expected to fail on 1-2 px cracks at stride 16, which documents why a detail path is needed.
min_experiment: One run under the benchmark protocol; report crack IoU, relF1@2, mIoU_rob; no kill, reference.
prior_overlap: Close to the closed frozen linear probes (DINOv3 ViT-S), but with multi-level features and ViT-L; low expected gain.
